shorts.thesis: WSJ reports the board is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang; NYT reported a second alleged affair. Baird cut to Neutral (PT $500 to $200), Bernstein halved its PT ($400 to $200), Morgan Stanley removed it from its preferred list. Governance overhang, not fundamentals.

Q3 revenue $981M beat the $907.5M estimate (+571% YoY) and 2027 guide of $12-13B is strong, but the CEO flagged December revenue slipping to February, putting 2026 revenue at the low end of the $3.0-3.4B range. Giving back Wednesday's +15% surge.

Q3 EPS $0.06 beat the $0.02 estimate, but sales of $1.6B missed and 2026 EBITDA guidance of ~$1.1B implies Q4 under $200M vs ~$400M expected; Citi called guidance 'sharply lower.' Earnings beat, guidance cut - the classic fade setup.
